reasoning: 16.2.3.3（PRE2.3.3）規定減少顯示的 bank 數時已存的 preset 會被保留，再次顯示時可還原。037 拆成兩個 leaf：058-01 保留、058-02 還原。與 COM-069／COM-076 相同的問題——「保留」無法獨立觀察，只有透過還原才看得見——故兩筆皆端對端驗證，以驗證標的區分：058-01 驗被隱藏的 preset 未被清除（還原後內容與隱藏前相同），058-02 驗還原動作本身使那些 preset 重新顯示。步驟刻意在被隱藏的 bank 中先存入可識別的電台，否則還原後無法判定是原本的 preset 還是空槽。容器錨定：Presets Shown 指示器同時出現在 Browse Presets List 與 ch18 的 Presets Pop up／Edit Presets Pop Up。PRE2.3.x 的條文位於 ch16，故本批一律在 Browse Presets List 操作與觀察，ER 逐行指名該容器；彈窗內的對應行為屬 APP3（ch18），不在此產生。優先級：preset 遺失是實質資料損失，兩筆皆 P1。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 058-01 驗被隱藏的 preset 內容未遺失，058-02 驗重新顯示後那些 preset 回到清單，驗證標的不同

tcs.test_item:
The system shall retain saved presets when the number of displayed preset banks is reduced.

(Hidden presets survive a reduction, in the Browse Presets List)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. FM is the active source on the HU
2. The Presets Shown indicator is set to more than one preset bank
3. At least one preset in the last displayed bank holds a stored station
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Browse" on the Tab Buttons to open the Browse Tab
3. Press the "Presets" category in the Categories Bank to open the Browse Presets List
4. Record the station stored on a preset entry in the last displayed bank of the Browse Presets List
5. Press the decrease control of the Presets Shown indicator once and read the preset entries displayed in the Browse Presets List
6. Press the increase control of the Presets Shown indicator once and read the station stored on that preset entry
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and FM is the active source
2. The Browse Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The Browse Presets List is displayed in the Browse List
4. The station on that preset entry is recorded
5. That preset entry is no longer displayed in the Browse Presets List
6. That preset entry displays the station recorded in step 4

tcs.test_item:
The system shall restore previously hidden presets when additional preset banks are shown again.

(Hidden bank shown again, in the Browse Presets List)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. FM is the active source on the HU
2. The Presets Shown indicator is set to more than one preset bank
3. At least one preset in the last displayed bank holds a stored station
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Browse" on the Tab Buttons to open the Browse Tab
3. Press the "Presets" category in the Categories Bank to open the Browse Presets List
4. Record the preset entries displayed in the Browse Presets List and their stored stations
5. Press the decrease control of the Presets Shown indicator once and count the preset entries displayed
6. Press the increase control of the Presets Shown indicator once and read the preset entries displayed and their stored stations
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and FM is the active source
2. The Browse Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The Browse Presets List is displayed in the Browse List
4. The preset entries and their stored stations are recorded
5. Fewer preset entries are displayed than recorded in step 4
6. The preset entries displayed are the entries recorded in step 4 with the same stored stations
